in_hebrew.name: Graig
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Graig הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Old Welsh 'gwragedd' meaning spear or rod. This name was borne by several Welsh and Scottish saints. In Welsh mythology, the name was given to a guardian of the wild boar.

in_greek.name: Graig
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Powerful spear
in_greek.long_meaning: Graig είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. From the Old Welsh 'gwragedd' meaning spear or rod. This name was borne by several Welsh and Scottish saints. In Welsh mythology, the name was given to a guardian of the wild boar.
